audit.why: 48.91% over 184 recorded games is an even lane, and the difficulty text, diff enum and rating all already agree at 5.5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Skill, Skill, Kayle, Kayle. The packet chart and the mirror both say Ryze, Ryze, Ryze, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle, Ryze — and the whys[] captions already argue the packet's version (whys[1] and whys[2] describe a clean Ryze window, whys[3]/[4] a Kayle one, whys[6] a Ryze teamfight).
audit.why: Kayle is melee with no dash and no invulnerability until 6, so levels 1-3 are Ryze's; Celestial Blessing and Divine Judgment take 4-6; Nashor's takes first item; Ryze reclaims the game at two mana items through teamfights and Realm Warp.
audit.corrected: Six paired flips across phases[N].side and win[N] with matching ratings; phases[5] already read Kayle and stays.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] names Kayle's passive 'Holy Fervor' — it is Divine Ascent. No cooldown anywhere (packet defect: zero sequencing cues). wants.you[0] puts 'full-ranged form at level 6' while spikes[3] puts it at 11; neither level is in the kit file.
audit.why: Divine Ascent is the real passive. Radiant Blast is 12s at rank 1 and reduces resistances on the way through; Celestial Blessing is a flat 15s heal plus move speed; Divine Judgment is 160s at rank 1. Those are the punish windows the page never gave.
audit.corrected: Passive renamed, Q/W/R cooldowns written into whys[3], whys[4] and mid, and the unverifiable ranged-form level dropped from wants.you[0] in favour of the levels 2-3 window the kit does support.

audit.whatIsWrong: Celestial Blessing's heal is never answered; no Grievous Wounds timing on the page.
audit.why: A 15s heal on move speed is what lets her erase the chip from your rotation in extended trades.

edits.before: She gains Celestial Blessing move speed and stacks Starfire Spellblade faster at levels 4-5, making post-combo kiting easier while your mana costs remain high pre-item.
edits.after: Celestial Blessing heals and speeds her on a flat 15 seconds, so she kites your combo cooldown and erases the chip — Grievous Wounds is what makes levels 4-5 trades stick.

edits.before: Divine Judgment comes online at level 6 — she can pop invulnerability inside your root, wasting your entire committed combo and leaving you on full cooldowns.
edits.after: Divine Judgment arrives at 6 on a 160-second cooldown — she pops invulnerability inside your root and the committed combo is wasted, so only go once you have seen it spent.

edits.before: Keep you at auto range pre-6 to stack her Passive (Holy Fervor) stacks and deny your melee-range E pattern safely
edits.after: Hold you at auto range pre-6 so Divine Ascent keeps ramping while your 615-range Spell Flux never reaches her

edits.before: Root her with W before she reaches full-ranged form at level 6 so she cannot safely kite your Flux chains
edits.after: Spell Flux then Rune Prison at levels 2-3, while she still has no dash and no invulnerability to answer it

edits.before: From levels 4-5 she still has no ranged form and no dash, but her Celestial Blessing (W) gives her a move speed burst that makes kiting your post-combo cooldown easier, and her Starfire Spellblade (E) empowered auto starts to stack damage faster — she is not threatening you but she is also no longer passive. At level 6 she gains a major defensive tool in Divine Judgment (R invulnerability): never commit your full W-root-into-empowered-Q if her R is available, because she will pop it the instant she is rooted and your window is wasted entirely. Use your Realm Warp to pressure other lanes if she sits back farming — your macro map pressure is worth more than a coin-flip 1v1 while her invulnerability is up.
edits.after: From levels 4-5 she still has no dash, but Celestial Blessing heals and speeds her on a flat 15 seconds, letting her kite your combo cooldown, and Starfire Spellblade's empowered auto starts to bite — no longer passive, not yet threatening. Radiant Blast is 12 seconds at rank 1 and cuts your resistances on the way through, so step up once it is spent, never into it. At 6 Divine Judgment lands on 160 seconds: never commit Rune Prison into empowered Q while it is available, because she pops it the instant she is rooted and the whole rotation is wasted. If she sits back farming, Realm Warp another lane — map pressure beats a coin-flip 1v1 with invulnerability up.

notes: The level chart was the big defect here: both layers said Kayle wins levels 2-3 while the captions underneath them described a clean Ryze root window, and the packet and mirror both say Ryze. Flipped six rows in matched pairs. Passive name corrected (Divine Ascent, not Holy Fervor). I deliberately did NOT restate which level Kayle goes ranged — the kit file only says range comes as she levels, and the page contradicted itself with 6 and 11; spikes[3] still says 11 and I left it rather than assert a number I cannot verify. Flagged in unverified.
